_README: Optional PIN gate. SHIPS DISABLED. Generate a replacement for this file from the admin panel at #/admin — never hand-write a PIN here. IMPORTANT: this is a SOFT GATE, not security. EDMGLAB is a static site, so anyone with the URL can open data/formulas.json (or any other file) directly without ever passing this PIN. Everything committed to this repository must still be safe to be public.
_mode: 'shared' = one PIN for the group. 'users' = a PIN per person, which also keeps each person's saved progress separate on a shared lab machine.
message: Enter the lab access PIN to continue.
_rememberDays: How long a device stays unlocked. 0 = prompt on every visit.
_pin: Used when mode is 'shared'. Generated by the admin panel: a PBKDF2-SHA256 derivation with a random salt — never the PIN itself. Example shape: { "salt": "...", "hash": "...", "iterations": 150000 }
_users: Used when mode is 'users'. Each entry: { "name": "Krishna", "slug": "krishna", "salt": "...", "hash": "...", "iterations": 150000 }
